description: Enables users to view and analyze the Pragma request headers sent by Akamai servers in real time. Ideal for web developers, network engineers, and security professionals, it helps to monitor the caching behavior, manage CDN configurations, and troubleshoot issues related to Akamai's content delivery network. Simply activate the extension to inspect the headers and gain deeper insights into the network and server-side performance
name: Akamai Pragma Headers Viewer
